tagline: 柯达便携相机，1928 年发布
description: 柯达于1928年推出的便携相机。

specs.英文简介:
“The Modern Camera for the Modern Girl” Brian Coe, Kodak Cameras, the First Hundred Years (Hove, UK: Hove Foto Books, 1988; ISBN 0-906447-44-5) p.167

The Vanity Kodak is a Vest Pocket Kodak Series III camera that has grained leather covering with gold lines and was made from 1928 to 1933.
